text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ――One, two, three, four! Hah!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hello, Tap-san. Are you studying dance?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Nope? This is "judo" practice!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Judo...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna cultivate "flexibility," 
dancing is the obvious first step, right?! 
It's perfect for making your whole body 
supple!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...? Although, while 'Judo' 
literally translates to the 'gentle way,' 
that's a bit different from flexibility in 
dancing...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Oops! In that case, I might've taught 
Kris S the wrong thing."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...To practice the 'softness' of judo, 
one's daily mindset is paramount. In other 
words――)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Fabric softener. A little more... than 
usual—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: K-Kris S-san, wait up...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I ended up throwing out a lot of 
retorts, but... indeed, flexibility is 
essential to judo.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"You see, in Japan, there is a saying: 
'Softness subdues hardness'..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
For the physically weaker to gently parry 
an opponent's brute force and use it 
against them to throw them— that is the 
true essence of judo.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In a book I read long ago, there was a 
record of a petite, elderly judoka who 
managed to throw a two-meter-tall 
Umamusume heel wrestler.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"After the match, the wrestler reportedly 
said: 'He threw me as if I were nothing 
more than thin air.' —So it goes."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—Now that's what I call romantic! Must be 
the real 'thrill' of judo!”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The 'ju' in judo does not refer to 
physical flexibility or the plushness of 
clothing—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Using the opponent's power against them: 
'Uke'. Reception—that is the very essence 
of judo."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —The Way of YAWARA— is deep...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! That was a thrilling story! If 
you can pull that off, you're a true 
“master”!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Rob Roy! With your advice in mind, 
I'm gonna master judo once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Like hell it is.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No. Put more into it, Kris S! A retort has 
to be much more comical!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, we won't be able to perform 
the ultimate comedy routine and master the 
'laughs' Rob Roy was talking about!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Shoot. Judo is... hard...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Japanese really is so difficult, 
isn't it!
